description: Low-frequency oscillator, 3HP — one waveform at a time

params.text: Rate; V/OCT is added to it
Selected by the button; square is fixed at half, pulse defaults to a tenth and is set on the menu
Adds a fixed voltage to the output, up to 5V either way; the menu widens that to 10V
Attenuates the wave before the offset is added, from full level down to nothing

inputs.text: Pitch at a volt per octave, added to the rate knob; the channels patched here set the polyphony

outputs.text: The wave, 5V either way after the scale and offset, clamped at 12V

menu: Offset range — sets what the OFFSET control covers, +/-5V or +/-10V
Output sampling — a slider, 0 to 100%, holding the output between samples so it steps
Pulse width — a slider setting the width of the pulse wave, which starts at 10%
Smoothing — a slider, 0 to 100%, slew-limiting the output
Reset phase on wave change — picking a different wave restarts it at phase zero rather than carrying on from where the old one had reached
